title: Text Manipulation
task: Use access.log to write one route per 5xx request to errors.txt in input order. Write one count and route per line to counts.txt, sorted by route, with a single space between count and route.
hints: Check the position of the status column.
Use awk to print field 2 only when field 3 is in the 500s.
Pipe the filtered input through sort, uniq -c, and awk.

checks.label: The filtered routes are correct
checks.feedback: Match the status field and preserve input order.

checks.label: The counts match the access log
checks.feedback: Sort routes before counting, then use single-space formatting.

demo.explanation: The last stage removes the padding around the count.

quiz.prompt: Which part of the log should you compare to find server errors?
choices: The whole line as a string
quiz.explanation: Compare field 3 numerically. A route can contain 500 while its status is 200.

quiz.prompt: Why sort routes before running uniq -c?
choices: uniq only groups adjacent equal lines
quiz.explanation: Sorting brings equal routes together. uniq -c counts each adjacent group.
